title: Chapter 857
paragraphs: Chapter 857
213th Episode. Rift, The Precursor to a Major Change (4)
Tower of Stories, Elona's office.
"So White Whale and Zed Runcandel, the Black Knights of the previous generation, have returned...."
Veradin commented as he reviewed the newsletter on the table.

All the newsletters were covering the news of the returnees including Luna Runcandel. In particular, the newsletters from Huphester elaborately described their heroic deeds, such as extinguishing the massive rift in Xiatello, immediately upon their return.
"Who is White Whale?"

"He is one of the first Runekendels who went to the Black Sea with Chiron Runcandel, Lady Elona. He's known as the strongest of his generation, no, the strongest knight in Runcandel, excluding Chiron."
Elona nodded at Ronil's explanation.
"Is it still the case now?"

"Well, it's not certain now that Jin Runcandel, the current clan leader, is here. White Whale has been away in the Black Sea, and it's been quite a while since he actually wielded his influence. But considering his status when he was most active... he probably wouldn't lag too far behind Jin Runcandel. He might even be stronger. After all, White Whale must have also achieved something."
"I'm reminded of the evaluation of the traitor, Kelliark Zipfel, about White Whale."
"What was his assessment, Satrin?"

"Luna Runcandel is a figure who holds a chance of victory against anyone in the world, even if that opponent is Chiron or himself. That's what he said. In fact, the traitor was most cautious about White Whale after Chiron Runcandel when he was the clan leader."
"A figure who always has a chance of victory, no matter who the opponent is..."
As Elona said this, she recalled her memories from a thousand years ago.
There were people like that back then, too.
"I'm reminded of Temar and the Emperor. Just like Jin Runcandel and Luna Runcandel now, they were a sibling pair with a good relationship."
Naturally, those two were the opponents Elona was most wary of at the time. Even though they were both clearly weaker than her, she felt anxious when she fought against them.
'There was one more person besides those two... who was it? Anyway, Runcandel is strong now, just like back then.'
Jin Runcandel, Luna Runcandel.

Elona repeated their names in her mind, and felt a strong desire to avoid meeting them if possible. However, she knew she would inevitably have to fight them someday. That time had to be when she had regained all her strength and awakened.

"If there is any consolation, it's that the immense energy I felt from the Black Sea not too long ago... it wasn't Chiron Runcandel returning personally. Ah, on the other hand, the fact that there's another figure of that caliber even without Chiron seems problematic...! White Whale wouldn't have awakened, but he cleanly extinguished the rift like me...! Ugh."
"Lady Elona."
"Yes, Clan Leader."
"Don't worry too much. It won't be like a thousand years ago, you won't have to face them alone."
Elona blinked and met Veradin's gaze. He always understood her inner thoughts.
"It's comforting to hear you say that, Clan Leader."
"Considering they have started to flex their power not only in Runcandel but also the Red Shadow Tribe, and now even in what we believe to be another underground force, I am sure you were restless."
Rift.

The signs of demonic transition were continuing in the Lutero Federation as well. As Muming identified a while ago, the reason for Zipfel's major defeat in the battle with the Red Shadow Tribe was because Elona left the battlefield to remove the rift.

"It seems so. Based on what I recently confirmed through the tower, they are probably demons... a type of demon we've never encountered. We have never been able to directly communicate, but they are creating dimensional gates in our territory without permission, they are sure to become our enemies."
Zipfel had understood that the rift was a type of summoning magic.
"These demons will eventually summon their base somewhere in Lutero."
"We can't remove all the rifts with the tower..."

"That's not your responsibility, Lady Elona. Rather, it's our incompetence for not being able to create a means of spatial transition like the Vamel Federation. Anyway, once their base is formed, we plan to meet them immediately."
Veradin was considering negotiations with the demon world. It was overwhelming to add them to the ongoing war with the Red Shadow Tribe.

"If they are the type to communicate, it might be an opportunity to completely drive out the Red Shadow Tribe. As soon as the Shrine Maiden's prayers are over, I'll have her find out more about the demons."
The sun religion's Shrine Maiden, Sanna. She was currently praying to find Kelliark Zipfel. Sheenu and Kelliark's powers were still essential to complement the Devil's Stone and the Tower of Stories.

"We also need to prepare for the case where the demons do not respond to negotiations. Above all, the relationship between them and the Red Shadow Tribe would be the most important... for now, we'll just watch."
Demon World, Sword Demon Castle.
"Is it true that twenty-three of the thirty rifts that Lord Zito formed on the surface and middle world have been destroyed...."
Phaelito said, drinking the spirit wine in his glass.

"The liquor was made from the souls of the surface and middle world who couldn't fit into the cycle of reincarnation and fell into hell. The anguished screams of the souls concentrated in the liquor helped ease his uneasy mind.

"I anticipated it, but to think that Lord Zito's magic was damaged, it's indescribably unpleasant. Considering the time it took for me to first neutralize Lord Zito's energy... the fact that such short-lived humans managed to do so is astonishing."
"That's why humans need to be controlled through suffering. After the Sun God died, they started to possess too many possibilities."
"You're right, Sakiel."
"According to the information obtained from the witch this time, the person who removed the most important rift is a person named Ben Gunn Luna Runcandel."
"You mean the rift in Siatelo. She's the daughter of Chiron Runcandel who came back from the Black Sea."
"Yes, that's right."
"If it's true that she used the red energy, this Luna is the most dangerous figure to Lord Zito now, along with Chiron Runcandel."
Sakiel handed over the report containing Luna's information. Phaelito scrutinized the report as he savored the spirit wine.
He was considering how to inflict pain on Luna.
Soon Phaelito was able to find her weakness.
"For someone with such power, she's a human with a weak heart and lots of affection."
"Most humans on the surface are like that. Even Jin Runcandel, one of the highest-ranking individuals, is the same."
"However, unlike Jin Runcandel, this friend Luna Runcandel seems to have a subtle sense of guilt towards her kin."
Soon, a smile crept up on Phaelito's face.
"Sakiel."
"Yes, Lord Phaelito."

"Temporarily stop the production of spirit wine from now on. And search hell thoroughly, check if Luna Runcandel's brothers exist. They must have fallen into hell. If they haven't already become spirit wine, they will certainly be left."
"Inducing psychological pain through guilt, you're going to use a classic method."
"Classics always set an example. Oh, has the life or death of that insect-like Basset been confirmed?"
Basset Biseks.
He was the leader of the Biseks clan in the Demon World and a key executive of the resistance forces opposing Zito.
"Lord Dialus' pursuit team seems to have caught his tail once."
"He's quite tenacious, surviving a fatal blow from me and running away like that. How many escapes has it been now? At this point, I can't tell if I'm incompetent or if he's exceptional."
"I think Basset was just lucky. Should I tell them to increase the pursuit team?"
Phaelito thought for a moment and shook his head.

"No, leave him be. It seems like he's trying to survive by any means and wants to be connected with the forces on the surface in the future... It wouldn't be bad to give him greater despair then. Just look after hell properly."
"Understood."
The Garden of Swords.
"Ah, my ear suddenly itches. Is someone talking about me?"
Luna said, rubbing her ear.
"By now, the whole world is probably talking about you and the returnees. If your ear is just itching, that's good."
"Well, that's true."
The grand return ceremony of Luna, Zed, and the former Black Knights had just ended. And Jin was sitting face to face with Luna alone, talking for the first time in a long while.
There was a pile of backlog of stories.
After Luna left for the Black Sea, Jin found the seven tombs of Temar, declared the reign of the universe, developed Tikan, and experienced the Sword Emperor Temple and Gliek Temple.
He brought down Joshua, ended the Foul Deity Temple, and endured numerous trials and pains.
Luna was most hurt by the death of her brothers. She also most enjoyed hearing about the brothers who had joined forces to protect the family until the end.
"Joshua, Myu, Anne, Ran, Bueg... I was too careless with them. It would have been better if I had taken care of them more so they wouldn't go astray."
"It's not your fault."
Jin naturally thought Luna would shake her head at that. That she would surely be distressed thinking she has a big responsibility.
But Luna, only making a bit of a bitter expression, was nodding.

"You're right. It's not my responsibility, after all, one chooses and takes responsibility for one's own life. I didn't turn my back on them to let them go astray and fall apart. It's not that I don't feel sorry at all, it's sad that we brothers had to kill each other. But more than that, I'm proud that you did what was right as a Runcandel, and I feel more sorry for you."
"Please stop saying you're sorry to me, Sister. How sorry are you going to be? It's not like you were having fun in the Black Sea."
"So should I? Well, anyway! If the day comes when I meet those estranged guys again, I'll have to scold them."
"Do you think we'll meet again?"
"Since I'll grow old and die someday too, won't we meet in some kind of afterlife?"
"Even if the afterlife does exist, you and they will probably be in different places."
"Is that so? Anyway, that's how I feel. I'll definitely scold them. Whenever it happens, as long as I meet them."
Jin laughed at Luna, who exaggeratedly clenched her fist.
"Now that you've heard a lot of my story, please tell me yours. What happened in the Black Sea during this time?"
